tools.name: list_resources
tools.intent: What the running AppHost is actually running: every resource with its state, health, endpoints and available commands. The orientation call before any other.

tools.name: list_console_logs
tools.intent: Read one resource's console output — the first place to look when a service starts and immediately dies.

tools.name: list_structured_logs
tools.intent: Structured log records across the app, filterable to one resource, when console output is too noisy to read.

tools.name: list_traces
tools.intent: Distributed traces across resources: which hop in a request was slow or threw, without adding instrumentation.

tools.name: list_trace_structured_logs
tools.intent: The log records belonging to one trace, to read a single failing request end to end.

tools.name: execute_resource_command
tools.intent: Start, stop or restart a resource — the write call, so name the resource deliberately.

tools.name: list_apphosts
tools.intent: Which AppHosts are detected and in scope, when more than one solution is running.

tools.name: select_apphost
tools.intent: Choose which AppHost the other calls address; required before them when several run at once.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.intent: Which Aspire hosting integration packages exist, when wiring a new dependency into the AppHost.

tools.name: get_integration_docs
tools.intent: Documentation for one integration package, rather than guessing its builder API from memory.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.intent: Search aspire.dev by keyword — the entry point when the question is 'how does Aspire do X'.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.intent: Fetch one documentation page in full once search has named it.

tools.name: doctor
tools.intent: Diagnose the local Aspire environment when a command fails for reasons that are not the code.
